organizer.name: ANNT
organizer.fullName: Asocijacija za napredak nauke i tehnologije
organizer.about: ANNT brings together young scientists and experts in Bosnia and Herzegovina and abroad. Its work supports science, technology, and education in BiH.

cards.title: Agent marketplace
cards.description: Work out how people install and use agents, then build two they will want to keep using.
deliverables: Define how people install an agent, talk to it, and help it improve through feedback.
Publish the agent offering in the App Store.
Ship two useful agents, including a reviewer agent.
cards.format: One open team per challenge. Contributors share the prize.

cards.title: Game studio
cards.description: Build a studio that takes a game idea through to a playable game.
deliverables: Generate textures, sprites, and sound, and bring them into the game.
Invite others to test what you make.
Ship a small game made with the studio to show that the whole flow works.
cards.format: One open team per challenge. Contributors share the prize.

cards.title: Multiplayer & shared worlds
cards.description: Let people on different Möbius instances play and explore together.
deliverables: Build a lobby people from different Möbius instances can join.
Ship two games that use it.
Create one shared space to explore together.
cards.format: One open team per challenge. Contributors share the prize.
cards.risk: Live multiplayer across instances probably needs a relay, so this flagship may be partly platform work.

cards.title: Immersive gallery
cards.description: Build a 3D exhibition people can walk through on a phone or computer.
deliverables: Build a walkable 3D exhibition.
Make navigation intuitive on both phone and desktop.
Bonus: display the hackathon’s art and memes, and host the closing ceremony in the gallery.
cards.format: Multiple entries can compete for one prize.

cards.title: Private pro desk
cards.description: Build a finance or science app with an agent that works in the background.
deliverables: Create a useful finance or science app with a background agent.
For example, review bank exports each month, or track new papers alongside a lab notebook.
Keep the data on the user’s own server.
cards.format: Multiple entries can compete for one prize.

cards.title: Möbius speaks
cards.description: Let people hear what the agent is doing and interrupt it by speaking.
deliverables: Have the agent explain aloud what it is doing as it works.
Let the user interrupt by voice.
Stretch goal: hands-free chat. This brief is platform work.
cards.format: Multiple entries can compete for one prize.

cards.title: Bug reports
cards.description: Found a bug in Möbius or fixed one? Share it here so others can confirm it, avoid it, or build on your fix.
deliverables: Describe what went wrong and how to make it happen again.
Add a screenshot if it helps.
Fixed it? Link your change and say what it improves.
cards.format: For fixes and improvements merged into Möbius. At the end, the organizers review all contributions together and decide how the pool is shared.

rules.title: The event
rules.text: ANNT is organizing Hackaton 2026 from 28 September to 9 October 2026. The goal is to add apps to the Store, build and test together in Social, and improve Möbius apps and the platform. Everything runs through this app.

rules.title: Team formats
rules.text: Each flagship bounty has one open team whose contributors share the prize. Open briefs allow multiple entries, with one winner per brief.

rules.title: Eligibility & prize limits
items: Maximum two cash prizes per person.
The platform pool and Community MVP do not count toward the cap.
Only projects published in the App Store count.

rules.title: How the jury decides
rules.text: The jury chooses the winners. There is no public vote.
items: Works well on phone and web.

rules.title: Platform contributions
rules.text: The 1,200 BAM platform pool is for fixes and improvements merged into Möbius. There is no points system: at the end, the organizers will review all contributions together and decide how the pool is shared.

rules.title: Details still to come
rules.text: The jury members, exact submission deadlines, and method for splitting prizes among contributors will be announced later.
